title: Privacy Policy
subtitle: How I collect, use, and protect your personal information
introduction: At Rohim Dev, I am committed to protecting your privacy and ensuring the security of your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how I collect, use, and safeguard your data when you visit my website or engage my services.

sections.title: Information I Collect
content: Personal Information: When you contact me through my website, I collect information such as your name, email address, phone number, and any other information you provide in your message.
Usage Data: I automatically collect information about how you interact with my website, including your IP address, browser type, pages visited, time spent on pages, and other browsing actions.
Cookies and Similar Technologies: My website uses cookies and similar tracking technologies to enhance your browsing experience and collect information about how you use the site.

sections.title: How I Use Your Information
content: To provide and maintain my services
To respond to your inquiries and communicate with you
To improve my website and services
To analyze usage patterns and administer the site
To protect my website and services from unauthorized access or activities

sections.title: Data Security
sections.content: I implement appropriate security measures to protect your personal information from unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction. However, no method of transmission over the Internet or electronic storage is 100% secure, and I cannot guarantee absolute security.

sections.title: Third-Party Services
content: I may use third-party services to help operate my website and provide services. These third parties may have access to your personal information only to perform specific tasks on my behalf and are obligated not to disclose or use it for any other purpose.
Third-party services I use may include: Hosting providers, Analytics services, Email service providers, Payment processors (when applicable)

sections.title: Cookies Policy
content: Cookies are small text files that are placed on your device when you visit my website. I use cookies to enhance your browsing experience and understand how you interact with my site.

The types of cookies I use include: Essential Cookies (necessary for the website to function properly), Analytical/Performance Cookies (help me understand how visitors interact with my website), Functionality Cookies (allow the website to remember choices you make)
You can control cookies through your browser settings. However, disabling certain cookies may limit your ability to use some features of my website.

sections.title: Your Data Protection Rights
content: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights regarding your personal information: The right to access your personal data, The right to rectify inaccurate personal data, The right to request deletion of your personal data, The right to restrict processing of your personal data, The right to data portability, The right to object to processing of your personal data
To exercise any of these rights, please contact me using the information provided at the end of this policy.

sections.title: Children's Privacy
sections.content: My website is not intended for children under 16 years of age. I do not knowingly collect personal information from children under 16. If you are a parent or guardian and believe your child has provided me with personal information, please contact me, and I will take steps to remove that information.

sections.title: Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.content: I may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in my practices or for other operational, legal, or regulatory reasons. I will post the updated Privacy Policy on this page with a revised "Last updated" date. I encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically to stay informed about how I protect your information.

sections.title: Contact Information
sections.content: If you have any questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy or my data practices, please contact me at rohimjoy70@gmail.com

agreementStatement: By using my website, you acknowledge that you have read and understand this Privacy Policy.
